explanation: Sketch over encryptorSetup_close and leafView_close_succinct. Each view draws B, the binary xs and (W, T) from the setup kernel, then a continuation; the draws of xs and (W, T) commute (PMF.bind_comm), so a view is the joint law of (B, row blocks of W, T) followed by a common continuation. The joint law with leafSetupEnc is encLaw mapped to row blocks, with leafSetup it is chalLaw mapped likewise; so real(enc) ~ real(chal) and sim(chal) ~ sim(enc) within the setup bound (CloseTo.map, bind_left), and real(chal) ~ sim(chal) by leafView_close_succinct.
